_key.description: Variant key, genomic element key, strand token, biosample term and source file accession joined by underscores, hashed with SHA-256 when the composite would exceed the key length limit.

genomic_element.description: Reference to the genomic element (hyper-edge); the variant effect is measured in this element in the given biosample.

strand.description: Strand of the MPRA tile in the reference sequence design (e.g. +, -, or . when unknown). Distinguishes same coordinates on opposite strands.

bed_score.description: Score column of the source BED file, which sets how dark the feature is drawn in a genome browser, on a scale of 0 to 1000.

log2FC.description: Fold change in reporter activity attributable to the variant: the alternate allele's output over input ratio divided by the reference allele's, in log2 space.

DNA_count_ref.description: Input count (DNA) for the reference allele, normalized to counts per million and averaged across replicates.

RNA_count_ref.description: Output count (RNA) for the reference allele, normalized to counts per million and averaged across replicates.

DNA_count_alt.description: Input count (DNA) for the alternate allele, normalized to counts per million and averaged across replicates.

RNA_count_alt.description: Output count (RNA) for the alternate allele, normalized to counts per million and averaged across replicates.

neg_log10_pvalue.description: -log10 of the P-value for the variant effect. Null when the source file does not report one.

neg_log10_pvalue_adj.description: -log10 of the FDR-adjusted P-value (Q-value) for the variant effect. Null when the source file does not report one.

significant.description: Whether the variant effect passes the significance threshold applied at load time: a neg_log10_pvalue_adj of 1 or more, equivalent to an FDR of 0.1 or lower. False when no adjusted P-value is available.

postProbEffect.description: Posterior probability that the variant has a regulatory effect.

CI_lower_95.description: Lower bound of a 95% interval for the variant effect.

CI_upper_95.description: Upper bound of a 95% interval for the variant effect.

enum: variant effect on regulatory element activity

files_filesets.description: Handle of the files_filesets record for the file this measurement was read from.

biological_context.description: Plain-language summary of the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when the fileset carries no summary.
biological_context.example: glutamatergic neuron differentiated cell specimen, pooled cell specimen from IGVFDO6638HIAD

biosample_term.description: Ontology term for the biosample the assay was run in, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when the fileset lists no sample.

treatments_term_ids.description: Ontology term identifiers for the treatments applied to the samples for the purpose of perturbation, taken from the file's fileset metadata. Null when none were applied.

accessible_via.return: strand, log2FC, bed_score, DNA_count_ref, RNA_count_ref, DNA_count_alt, RNA_count_alt, neg_log10_pvalue, neg_log10_pvalue_adj, significant, postProbEffect, source, source_url, genomic_element
